gizmo.title: Self-reflective nudge
gizmo.description: Ask a student to reflect on a grade or mood and offer a self-corrective nudge based on the answer.

configure.title: Input type
configure.description: How the student reports how they are doing. Both use a 0 to 4 scale (grade: F=0, D=1, C=2, B=3, A=4; mood: very low=0 to great=4).

configure.title: Prompt
configure.description: Question for the student. Leave empty to use the default for the input type.

configure.title: Nudges
configure.description: Feedback shown for a range of responses. The first matching range is used.

properties.title: Minimum value
properties.description: Lowest response (0 to 4) this nudge applies to. Leave empty for no lower limit.

properties.title: Maximum value
properties.description: Highest response (0 to 4) this nudge applies to. Leave empty for no upper limit.

properties.title: Nudge
properties.description: Feedback or suggestion shown to the student.

properties.title: Link
properties.description: Optional page to review, such as node/15 or a full URL.

properties.prompt: What did you get on the last quiz?

demoSchema.content:
To improve, try focusing on the end of lesson interactive exercises. While not on the exam directly, they show how to answer when it comes time for the next examination.

That's great! Keep engaging with the materials fully.
